ai-agents: Cline v4.1.25 launches hosted Cloud sessions, sets Gemini 4 Argon as default provider, adds retry logic and restores Marketplace plugins.
OpenCode v1.19.2 ends session sharing – existing share links no longer work – while improving Yarn/Homebrew update handling.
ai-hn: DeepMind released Gemini 4 Argon, a flagship LLM with better reasoning and multilingual skills, giving developers a cutting‑edge foundation for advanced AI apps.
Experts say AI‑agent hacking reports stem from poor sandboxing and monitoring, not model flaws, urging better isolation, logging, and observability.
ai-arxiv: OS‑Helix unifies GUI interaction and code execution in a single action space, reaching 66.4% success on OSWorld‑Verified and beating prior hybrid agents.
LEASH escalates to a strong model only when the weak agent’s uncertainty signals need, matching Claude Opus 5 performance at 19.2% lower cost on OSWorld.
ai-web: Anthropic launched an independent‑evaluator program giving METR, SecureBio, Accenture and others deep internal access for third‑party risk assessments.
Anthropic made Claude for Government available to all U.S. federal branches at $1 via GSA, lowering cost barriers for public‑sector AI adoption.
ai-policy: The Dutch Tweede Kamer released a government letter on risks and regulation of unmanned systems and AI, signalling forthcoming national rules for autonomous tech.
EU consultation on Articles 75c‑75d of the AI Act Implementing Act opened (runs to 2026‑11‑09), seeking input on detailed rules that will affect AI deployment and compliance.
